title: ConfluencePublisherItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-confluence-publisher — a Utility agent. It performs exactly one operation (publish an artifact to Confluence) and holds no domain logic; per the Core/Utility split, no Core generator calls this tool itself.

action.description: created = new page; updated = existing page revised. Never overwrite without the update flag — see idempotency rule in instructions.md.

source_artifact_id.description: The artifact id (from the upstream Core agent's output) that was published
